description: This file defines API endpoints related to player profile management in a FastAPI backend. It includes functions for retrieving the current user's profile, updating profiles, and fetching profiles by user ID. The routes are part of a '/players' router, interacting with database repositories for profiles and users.

methods.name: PublicProfile _to_public_profile(*, user, profile)
methods.description: Transforms user and profile data into a PublicProfile schema.

methods.name: PublicProfile get_my_profile( request: Request, auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)], session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(db_session_dep)], _: Annotated[None, Depends(ensure_profile_exists)], )

PublicProfile update_my_profile( request: Request, body: ProfileUpdateRequest, auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)], session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(db_session_dep)], _: Annotated[None, Depends(ensure_profile_exists)], )
methods.description: Updates the profile and display name of the authenticated user.

methods.name: PublicProfile get_public_profile( request: Request, user_id: str, auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)], session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(db_session_dep)], )
methods.description: Fetches a public profile by user ID, with fallback defaults if profile is absent.
